approval_source: Explicit user SIGA after review of AN / EN / KUVAN / KU / KE reuse plan in HNK-LINGUAS.

decisions_requested.statement: Approve AUTH-016 AN for L02 FIRST_PERSON_REFERENT by extending curriculum scope to L02 with authority remaining CANDIDATE.
Approve AUTH-017 EN for L02 SECOND_PERSON_REFERENT by extending curriculum scope to L02 while preserving scoped behavior.
Approve AUTH-001 KUVAN for L02 LOCATION_INTERROGATIVE without making KU or VAN globally productive.
Approve AUTH-018 KU for L02 CONTENT_SELECTOR without assigning KU one universal WH gloss.
Approve AUTH-019 KE for L02 QUESTION_OPERATOR without creating universal HNK interrogative grammar.
Confirm scope-only changes to existing authored candidates; zero new surface forms and zero new language assets.
Preserve VANI and VANUVALI unresolved in L02 and do not generalize the L01 residence interpretation of VANI.
Keep L02 pedagogy authoring on HOLD after mapping; form selection alone does not authorize lesson payloads.
